selection_rule: numpy default_rng(13).permutation over the sorted list of 200 eligible persona ids; first 72 taken; slices [0:24] / [24:48] / [48:72] -> predictor_train / calibration / final_test. Simplest seeded persona-level split, no balancing (Phase-1 brief §2 preference).

row_filter.note: the brief specifies distance_to_ref_in_blocks > 0; that column exists in PersonaMem-v1 only. The v2 equivalent quantity is distance_from_related_snippet_to_query_128k (tokens between the evidence turn and the query). The 32k and 128k distance columns agree on the >0 predicate for every one of the 5000 rows, so the size choice does not affect the filter.
row_filter.category_rule_not_used: 3 sensitive_info rows have distance>0 and are RETAINED, confirming this is the distance criterion and not a category exclusion

option_shuffle.seeding: row_seed = hash(f'{persona_id}_{user_query.content + recall-instruction}') % 2**32, then random.seed(row_seed); random.shuffle([correct]+incorrect)
option_shuffle.env: PYTHONHASHSEED=13 exported before every relevant process
option_shuffle.reproducibility_verified: 200 rows, two fresh processes with PYTHONHASHSEED=13 -> identical seeds, option orders and correct letters; control run without the env var differs

seal: final_test persona membership is SEALED as of frozen_at_utc
